column1: # [OPUS-4.8] WatDiv per-commit expected result sizes (count mode = solution count).
# Differential check: at the FIXED SF=1 corpus (bench/watdiv/gen.sh 1, ~106k distinct
# triples after dedup; deterministic byte-identical output via the seed-pinned generator
# + vendored wordlist), each instantiated query's solution count is deterministic, so a
# row-count drift = a correctness regression. Format: <query>\t<rows>.
# Counts are independent of the wordlist CONTENT (they bind to typed/structural entities,
# not literal text — verified by regenerating with an alternate wordlist).
# Heavy-tier queries (F1/F4/C1/C2) are EMPTY at SF=1 (need scale) and live in
# queries-heavy/ — they are checked at the EC2/nightly SF>=10 tier, not here.
# Grouping: Linear L1-L5, Star S1-S7, Snowflake F2/F3/F5, Complex C3.
